apps.localizedDescription: TVContainer brings LiveContainer's essential features to Apple TV with an interface designed for your Siri Remote. Requires Apple TV running tvOS 17 or later. The IPA must be signed with an Apple TV development provisioning profile. See the project README for setup and compatibility details: https://github.com/hubzzzgr/TVContainer
